best_idea: Keep done-but-reveal-owed as its own state, separate from done, so a completion plays exactly once and the reveal itself moves the quest to done; the server ledger owns the first transition and the client only acknowledges the reveal.
decision_why: Keep the reveal-once state, but move the Completing write to the server ledger (one ledger). The donor keeps status in the UI object, which breaks the one-ledger ruling; the donor's quest rules and rewards are absent, so only this state shape transfers.
acceptance: A server test asserts that only completeQuest writes Completing and a client reveal ack can only move Completing to Completed; in the client a finished quest's reveal plays once per quest, including after closing the log and reopening on another tab.
